verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official `sv` CLI (npx sv create, sv add, sv check, playground-to-project scaffolding) documented in first-party docs, which is usable in AI-native/agentic workflows alongside the dedicated MCP server for agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (community evidence covers the framework generally, not sv CLI specifically) and explicit documentation of CLI usage in autonomous agent pipelines.
